components.name: Website selector
components.css: .ds-picker{font-family:'Encode Sans Variable',sans-serif;display:grid;gap:3px;color:var(--muted,#53677e);font-size:13px}.ds-picker select{font-family:'Encode Sans Variable',sans-serif;width:100%;min-height:42px;border:1px solid var(--border,#d9e1e7);border-radius:4px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink,#10233a);padding:8px 14px;font-size:16px}.ds-picker select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--rust,#b94d28);outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Navy navigation with rust current-page state.
components.css: .ds-nav{font-family:'Encode Sans Variable',sans-serif;background:var(--navy,#182c3d);padding:14px;display:grid;gap:10px}.ds-nav a{padding:12px 15px;color:#f2f5f6;font-size:17px;border-radius:4px;min-height:50px;text-decoration:none;transition:background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-nav a:hover{background:#2b4254}.ds-nav a.ds-active{background:var(--rust,#b94d28);color:#fff}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--rust,#b94d28);outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Report panel
components.description: Flat container preserving context when data is unavailable.

components.name: Summary measurement
components.description: Labeled unavailable measurement without sample metrics.

components.name: Date field
components.description: Date menu field with rust keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-date{font-family:'Encode Sans Variable',sans-serif;display:grid;gap:5px;color:var(--ink,#10233a);font-size:14px}.ds-date input{font-family:'Encode Sans Variable',sans-serif;border:1px solid var(--border,#d9e1e7);padding:8px 10px;border-radius:4px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink,#10233a);caret-color:var(--rust,#b94d28)}.ds-date input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--rust,#b94d28);outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Context bar
components.description: Header working context: the website select, and on report pages the date range with its Last 30 days shortcut. No status pills or account cards.
components.css: .ds-context{font-family:'Encode Sans Variable',sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:end;gap:24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border,#d9e1e7);min-height:104px;padding:16px 0;background:var(--canvas,#f6f5ef)}.ds-range{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:end;gap:12px}.ds-range-summary{display:grid;gap:3px;text-align:left;background:transparent;border:0;cursor:pointer;font:inherit}.ds-range-summary strong{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;min-height:42px;border:1px solid var(--border,#d9e1e7);border-radius:4px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink,#10233a);padding:8px 14px;font-size:16px;font-weight:400}.ds-shortcut{border:1px solid var(--border,#d9e1e7);border-radius:4px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink,#10233a);min-height:42px;padding:8px 14px;cursor:pointer}.ds-shortcut[aria-pressed='true']{border-color:var(--rust,#b94d28);color:var(--rust,#b94d28)}.ds-range-summary:focus-visible,.ds-shortcut:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--rust,#b94d28);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: User menu
components.description: Rail menu button (monogram, truncated email, chevron) opening email, Connections and Sign out; stays visible as a monogram button at 960px.

components.name: Data table
components.description: Ruled dense table: 11px muted headings, sortable header buttons with aria-sort, 12px body with tabular numerals, Fine Rule row lines, status as text beside a small dot, selection checkboxes, and a partial-data notice row.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-table{font-family:'Encode Sans Variable',sans-serif;width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink,#10233a)}.ds-table th{color:var(--muted,#53677e);font-weight:500;font-size:11px;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border,#d9e1e7);text-align:left}.ds-table td{padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #e8edf1}.ds-table time{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-table button{font:inherit;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;color:inherit}.ds-dot{display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#778798;margin-right:6px}.ds-table-notice td{color:var(--muted,#53677e);font-size:12px}.ds-table button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--rust,#b94d28);outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview:
Operations Desk pairs a persistent navy navigation anchor with an ivory work surface and white, finely ruled reports. Rust marks active navigation, actions, and the traffic line. The result is calm, practical, and deliberately flat.

Self-hosted Encode Sans carries both headings and dense report text. Strong totals, tabular numerals, and restrained supporting labels establish hierarchy without ornamental imagery. Data, account, loading, and empty states use the same materials.
keyCharacteristics: White panels with fine rules and modest corners
Rust for selection, actions, and chart emphasis
Readable report hierarchy with tabular numerals

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: Separate report surfaces with white fill and fine borders; do not add decorative panel shadows.

rules.name: The Readable Totals Rule
rules.body: Use tabular numerals for aligned measurements and retain explicit labels beside each total.

dos: Do retain navy navigation, ivory canvas, and white report surfaces.
Do use the rust focus outline and visible labels for controls.
Do preserve context and readable empty states while reports load.
Do let long domains wrap or truncate deliberately and keep numeric columns aligned.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, glass, or decorative shadows into report panels.
Don't replace actual report values or missing data with illustrative metrics.
Don't add prior-period deltas unless the underlying comparison is available.
